summary: Availability-only, fail-closed, non-security-regressing — nothing in the codebase treats 'root exists in ca_store' as sufficient without also successfully loading and cert/key-pairing the key (verified across every kp.load_key(root->key_ref) call site in server.cpp). Documented in the new Resource Ledger file rather than fixed — extending that unrelated check's own poll would delay a genuine lost-key refusal by up to 15s on every established install, a worse trade than the rare sibling-refusal it would prevent.
trigger: deferring the default-ca key write past try_insert_root's CAS opens a window (new relative to pre-fix, where the key file always existed before the ca_store row did) where a SIBLING process reaching the unrelated, pre-existing top-of-function B-2/UP-2 self-heal check sees has_key(root.key_ref)==false and refuses immediately rather than waiting
